verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures invests in early-stage Tough Tech companies developing hardware-based technologies across deep tech fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures is the investment fund that spun out from The Engine nonprofit incubator/accelerator in 2023. The Engine is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded by MIT in 2016. In 2023, the investment fund separated and rebranded as Engine Ventures. No current senior partners named explicitly on firm website or Wikipedia. AUM not disclosed in sources. Database entry lists founded year as 2023 which is CORRECT for Engine Ventures specifically (when it separated from The Engine). The broader organization (The Engine) was founded in 2016.
